role: One attribute modifier: an amount, an operation (0 add, 1 multiply base, 2 multiply total) and a UUID key, applied to an attribute instance by potions, equipment and spawn bonuses.

members.name: isSaved
members.note: saved flag; attr_mod also carries from_item for equipment modifiers that never reach NBT

members.name: AttributeModifier
members.note: native sites build struct attr_mod inline; the random-UUID draw this ctor gets from netherite.oracle.Det.uuid() appears per use site (spawning.c draws the spawn-bonus modifier's UUID off the seeder)

members.name: AttributeModifier
members.note: fields are set at every use site; the Validate checks (non-empty name, operation in 0..2) have no native counterpart

members.name: setSaved
members.note: mod.saved; the unsaved sprint boost and the from_item equipment modifiers are excluded from the Attributes tag in attr_instance_nbt

members.name: equals
members.note: mod_same compares only the UUID; Java also compares amount, operation and name

members.name: hashCode
members.note: attr_mod_bucket reproduces id.hashCode's HashMap bucket spread for NBT ordering, not the method itself

notes: The modifier model lives as struct attr_mod (living.h:56). Use sites seen: potion.c potion_apply_attributes (potion.moveSpeed/moveSlowdown/health boost/damage boost modifiers), spawning.c (random spawn bonus UUID draw), serverreplay.c cp_restore_living (func_151475_a NBT read), entity_nbt.c player_attributes. I did not verify any client-side AttributeModifier use. Not gaps (triage 2026-09-25, out/plan/remaining-2026-09-25.md): data structure or helper replaced by fixed arrays or inlined arithmetic (GPU contract), behavior covered by its callers; toString and Validate are debug only. Formerly listed as missing: toString has no native counterpart (debug output only). equals compares only the UUID in native (mod_same), while Java also compares amount, operation and name. the four-argument constructor's Validate checks (non-empty name, operation in 0..2) are enforced nowhere in native.
